text: For the Children is related to the seasonal world event Children's Week. If you complete this achievement you will be rewarded with the title Matron or Patron depending on your character's gender. This achievement is also a criterion of the meta-achievement What A Long, Strange Trip It's Been.
Forceful Eye of Zul is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting.

For the Alliance! is a meta PvP achievement earned for killing the leaders of the Horde located at each horde major cities. After completing this achievement, the player will receive the Reins of the Black War Bear in their mailbox.

__NOTOC__ Foreman Thaldrin is a frost vrykul found in the Saronite Mines of Ymirheim of Icecrown. Thaldrin oversees the mining of Saronite. He appears to be either too strong-willed, or too ignorant to be manipulated by the Old God Yogg-Saron, whose whispers can be heard echoing throughout the mine, slowly driving its inhabitants insane. Furthermore, he seems to be oblivious to his slaves' odd behavior, such as suicide, heightened aggression, and singing of hearing beautiful voices, caring only for them completing their work as effectively as possible. He was present during Death Rising.
Fordragon's Shield can be found in Dragonblight. Facing the Wrathgate the shield is found on the ground to the left of Alexstrasza.

Forest's Edge Post is a small trapper outpost in the Grizzly Hills. It features a watchtower and a small wooden house. A number of hunters from Silverbrook have taken up residence here, led by Vladek. Horde players visit this place to make sure that the trappers would not join the Alliance. That pact fell apart in any case after the Alliance's discovery that the people of Silverbrook were, in fact, worgen. After the incident at Silverbrook, Vladek and his people tried to blockade the road here. However, this ended in swift Alliance retribution.

Dampwick is a foreman who has lost his men while looking for ore in the mine on Lost Isles, whispering that his current miners are nowhere near as good as his old jungle troll miners back on Kezan. Dampwick is simultaneously attempting to retrieve the valuable Kaja'mite found in the mine while holding off the monkeys who've been made super intelligent by the legendary ore. Later on, Foreman Dampwick builds a rocket sling to get the goblins off of the smaller part of the Lost Isles. This brings the goblins to the bigger isle, where they set up the Town in a box. After the goblins escaped from the volcanic Lost Isles, he ends up in Bilgewater Harbor as a guard, making sure no civilian trespass

For Great Justice was a guild perk available at guild level 18 that increases Justice Points gain by 10%. When a raid mob is defeated, Justice Points are awarded, similar to Emblem of Frost and Emblem of Triumph in the Wrath of the Lich King expansion.
Forest Green Cloak is a quest reward from A New Era for the Plaguelands.
The Forbidden Sigil was provided as an objective for Forbidden Sigil (quest).
Foreman Glibbs is a goblin foreman located at the Orgrimmar Rear Gate in Azshara.
Footsteps of the Fallen Friend are a quest reward from An Ancient Enemy.
Foreman Sharpsneer's Head drops from Foreman Sharpsneer in the Silver Stream Mine in Loch Modan.
Foreman Fisk is a level 15 quest giver located at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange of Azshara. During the Legion Invasions, she defended the area.

Forba Slabchisel, a member of the Royal Stonecutters Union, was sent to what is now called Slabchisel's Survey by Muradin Bronzebeard. She's also one of the defenders of the Thandol Span during The Battle of Thandol Span.

Force was the planned main resource to be used by the monk class, coming in the World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria expansion. They would also have chi, which would be used to build up Force. There were two sides to the Force, a light side and a dark side. Each side would have its own benefits. As of the Mists of Pandaria beta there are only two resources used by the monk: Chi and energy.
__NOTOC__ Forest Ettins are ettins found at North Tide's Beachhead in Silverpine Forest.

The Forest Heart is a large wooded area found in central Jade Forest. It spans from the valley between the Tian Monastery and Dawn's Blossom. The Lair of the Jade Witch can be found near its southern end. It is bordered by (among other locations) the Silkwood. Much of the woods has become taken over by Jade Guardians, recently released by the Jade Witch, when a few pandaren children knocked on her door. Jade Forest 2.jpg|Another view of the forest heart Central Bamboo Forest.jpg|Underneath the Gong of Hope

Foreman Dunaer is a draenei that can be found with Valon in the Crystal Hall of the Exodar, on the same platform where Farseer Nobundo stands. During the Battle for the Exodar, he was inside Velen's protective shield.
Foreman Mann is a pandaren quest giver found at the Emperor's Omen in the Jade Forest.
__NOTOC__ Foreman Raike is a pandaren located at the Serpent's Heart in the Jade Forest.
__NOTOC__ Foreman Sharpsneer is a gnoll located at the Silver Stream Mine. He is part of the Axis of Awful and the foreman of the Silver Stream Mine.

The Grookin tribe, also known as the Forest Hozen, are an immature and impulsive race of monkey people. They find themselves allied with the Horde after the Horde gains their favor by rescuing some of their members, sating their appetite for fish, and killing some of their most fearsome enemies. They are enemies of the Pearlfin Jinyu.
Foreman Pikwik is a goblin quest giver located at the Irontree Clearing in the Northern Barrens. He is in charge of clearing Irontree Cavern.

For Council and King is a Zandalari lore object located on deck of the ship moored to the dock at Stormsea Landing on the Isle of Thunder. Interacting with the lore object is one of the requirements of the Isle of Thunder exploration achievement The Zandalari Prophecy.
__NOTOC__ Foreman Swindlegrin is a goblin located at the Suntouched Pillar in Sholazar Basin.
Forceful Jasper is created with Jewelcrafting (425); taught by Design: Forceful Jasper.
Foreman Zipfizzle is a gnome found in Lunarfall. He came to the post with the first wave and brought a Garrison Packmule.
Ford's Stopwatch was a testing item for the Garrison. When used, all garrison constructions would instantly finish.
__NOTOC__ Foreman Eksos is a draenei who joined the Alliance war effort on alternate Draenor, helping to build up the new base at Fort Wrynn in Talador.
Forest Owls are owls found to the west of Grove of Aessina in Mount Hyjal.

Foreman's Lunchbox is found at on the upper level of the scaffolding just inside the wall by the main entrance to the Archenon Siegeyard in northeastern Talador. This is a little platforming puzzle. Get on top of the upper scaffold by getting on top of the small hut just to the north of the scaffolding, then jump over to the other hut to the east, then on to the smaller scaffolding east of the hut, then on to the two small pillars and finally on to the upper scaffolding. Do it on foot. The lunchbox contains the Tasty Talador Lunch.
Forbidden Cave is a small cave under the Forbidden Glacier in Frostfire Ridge.
Foreman Grobash is an orc quest giver located at the Vol'jin's Pride in Talador.
For Prestige was an achievement earned by reaching Honor Prestige Level 4.
Forbearant Faithful is a Protection paladin artifact trait. It is linked to the Bastion of Truth and Stern Judgment traits.
Forbidden Marks of Inscription is a book found in the Chamber of the Guardian of Dalaran during the quest Dabbling in the Demonic.
Forest Huntresses are tigers found in northern Jade Forest. They hunt Smoky Porcupines.
Forest Prowlers are tigers found around the Path of Enlightenment and Tigers' Wood in northwestern Jade Forest.
Foraging Rats are rats located at Barrowknoll Cemetery in Drustvar.
__NOTOC__ Foreman Razorgnarl is a quilboar located at the Briarback Warrens in Stormsong Valley.
Foragers are gatherers from various humanoid and bestial races.
Sea Shanty of the Horse is looted from the Scoundrel's Songbook found in the sout-westernmost inn at the Ring of Booty in Tiragarde Sound.
Forbidden Descent is a raid achievement earned for defeating Portal Keeper Hasabel, Eonar's encounter, and Imonar the Soulhunter in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Foreman Al'jibo is a jungle troll located in the Hall of Ancient Paths in the Great Seal.
__NOTOC__ Foreman Jethek is a sethrak that wanders around central Zul'Ahjin in Vol'dun.
Forbidden Sea Shanty of the Lively Men is looted from Russel's Songbook in Boralus.
Forbidden Sea Shanty of Inebriation is looted from Jay's Songbook in Boralus.
The Forbidden Sea Shanty of the Black Sphere drops from Black-Eyed Bart at Daelin's Gate in Tiragarde Sound.
The Forbidden Sea Shanty of Josephus drops from Barman Bill in Freehold in Tiragarde Sound.
Forbidden Sea Shanty of Fruit Counting is looted from a Dusty Songbook in Tiragarde Sound.
The For da Blood God! is a toy that has a chance to drop from Talanji's Expedition Supplies.
Forbes Masson is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft.
Foreman Cogbutton is a goblin located in Bleak Hills Mine in Drustvar.

For the Queen is the alternative quest in the Fate of Saurfang questline made available only if players choose to side with Sylvanas during the interaction with Zekhan after the completion of Tracking Tipoff.
Footpads of the Illidari Crusade is rewarded from Soul Prism of the Illidari (quest).
The Footwraps of the Receding Nightmare are a quest reward from Darkheart Thicket: Enter the Nightmare.
Foreling Shard-Bearers are podling that would accompany Not So Friendly Foreling in .
Foraging was a planned secondary profession. It never made it past the alpha. Kesteryth was planned to be a trainer for this skill.
Foreman Kophen is a Forsaken located in Darkshore during the Battle for Darkshore.

Foreman Magrok is the leader of an orc peon revolt in the Twilight Highlands, encountered during the vulpera recruitment questline. He is first seen in the Peon Hideout, holding a speech for a group of Crushblow Peons. Aspiring to one day become warchief, Magrok is angered by the way peons have been treated and demands that the Horde give them more respect and better working conditions. To appease the peons and get them to resume work on a Crushblow outpost, Kiro and a Horde adventurer arrange a feast at Crushblow in their honor, which Magrok gladly accepts. However, while the peons seem satisfied and ready to get back to work, Kiro notes that there will always be a risk of another revolt if

Forceful Logic Board drops from HK-8 Aerial Oppression Unit and The Platinum Pummeler in Operation: Mechagon.
For Nazjatar! is a player vs. player achievement earned by winning the Battle for Nazjatar.
Forest Guardians are runestags located at Elder Stand in Ardenweald. They are accompanied by Runestag Younglings.
Foreman Au'brak is a broker located in the Hall of Shapes in Oribos.
Foreman Flatfinger is a dredger located in Sinfall in Revendreth.
The Forbidden Library is an area in southwestern Forest Ward that borders with and has access to the Ember Ward. It is a research facility for devourers.

For the Hoarder! is awarded to players who complete any of the six primary wings (that is, all but the Twisting Corridors) of Torghast, Tower of the Damned with at least 1000 Phantasma in the bank. This is easiest on a lower layer. Make sure to kill and loot every enemy, every Ashen Phylactery, and choose any Phantasma rewards from Anima Cells. Don't purchase any items from the broker on floor 3, and make sure to not dip below 1000 Phantasma with purchases from the broker on floor 6, right before the layer boss.
Footpads of the Serene Wake drop from the Tidesage Council in the Shrine of the Storm.
Forbidden Rites and other Rituals Necromantic is a tome found in Scholomance.
The Foreman's Chest is located on the upper floor of the Zerekriss in Maldraxxus during Search the Place.

Forbidden Weapon Schematics can be found on the corpses of all creatures in Korthia, more likely on rare and rare-elite enemies (for Conquering Korthia), and inside other Relic Fragment-containing lootables around the zone. Turn the item to Archivist Roh-Suir at the Reliquary of Remembrance of Keeper's Respite for 100 Cataloged Research and 50 reputation with the Archivists' Codex.
Forest Defenders are vorkai located at the Ring of Transference in Oribos during Opening to Oribos.
Forbidden Necromantic Tome is dropped by Kel'Thuzad in the Sanctum of Domination.
Footpads of Seeping Dread drop from Viceroy Nezhar in the Seat of the Triumvirate.

Foreboding Bracers are a quest reward from Silence of the Dwarves.

Footwraps of the Insatiable Maw is obtained from multiple sources.
Forest Shriekers are dread ravens encountered by adventure companions in Ardenweald.
Forbidden Ink is found in the Forbidden Library in Revendreth. The ink can be handed over to the Lost Quill in order to acquire the Refilling Inkwell.
__NOTOC__ Forbidden Chamber Lockbox is found sealed away inside a tower in the Charred Ramparts in Revendreth. It is part of the process to loot the Stonewrought Sentry.
Forerunner's Relic Blade drops from Artificer in Sepulcher of the First Ones.
Forbidden Truth drops from The Jailer in Sepulcher of the First Ones.
Forager's Stew is sold by innkeepers and food vendors throughout the Dragon Isles.
Forceful Nozdorite is created with Dragon Isles Jewelcrafting (25); taught by Design: Forceful Nozdorite.
For Imbu! is a rare elite world quest located in Imbu in southeastern Azure Span. As an elite quest, progress can be gained in a raid group.
Foraging Chickens are chickens located in Camp Nowhere in the Azure Span. One is being chased by Miqa‎.

The Forbidden Hoard spawns at various locations around the Forbidden Reach. The chest contains a Zskera Vault Key, roughly 500 Elemental Overflow, and occasionally a Primalist loot token or an Untapped Forbidden Knowledge. While on Plunder Siege, Atrenosh's Journal can be found inside. Opening ten hoards is the objective of Forbidden Spoils, itself a criterion of You Know How to Reach Me.
Forest's Flow is a Restoration druid talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Wild Synthesis.
Forbidden Spoils is an exploration achievement earned by opening 10 Forbidden Hoards around the post-storm Forbidden Reach.

The forge is a large metalworking furnace object. It is used for smelting various metal ores gathered from mining. You do not interact with the forge, you just have to be in the vicinity of the forge to smelt. They can be found around most Dwarven towns and other races' encampments too, but occasionally at mob encampments also. Forges are often found paired with an anvil (which has similar use characteristics). Blacksmith shops will always contain a forge.

Forestlord and the First Druids is a part of tauren mythology. It is recorded in-game in a scroll hanging behind Hamuul Runetotem in the Arch Druid's tent on Elder Rise, Thunder Bluff. It is evidence of the druidic heritage that the Tauren race lost and is recently trying to regain.

The Forlorn Cavern is a long, winding road built around Ironforge's underground lake. Its naturally dark and secluded nature makes it perfect for lots of shady deals. Rogue and warlock trainers can be found here (the latter inside the Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms), as well as vendors catering to those classes. The Cavern also holds two shops, the Stoneblade's and the Traveling Fisherman. To get to the Forlorn Cavern, you can head east from the Mystic Ward or west from the Hall of Explorers. It is recommended to be careful in the Forlorn Cavern, where dark things are going on, while risking encountering thieves and warlocks.
Forest Wisp is a wisp quest giver located north of the Darnassus entrance in Teldrassil.
Forged Steel Bars are contained in Stolen Iron Chest in the Barrens.

The Forgotten Pools are the northernmost of the oases in the Northern Barrens, located north off the western road out of the Crossroads. As with many of these verdant pools, it is patrolled by Kolkar centaurs along with the indigenous wildlife, such as turtles. Laden Mushrooms are unique to this pool, and grow along its shore. Ta'jari and Telar Highstrider can be found here, assessing the centaur threat. This is one of only three fishing locations where Deviate Fish can be found. During the Burning Legion's invasions, the pools fall under the Legion's control. All residents, including the centaur, were killed by the demons. Forest Song is located in northeastern Ashenvale, just northeast of Satyrnaar, north of the Warsong Lumber Camp, and southwest of Bough Shadow. It is an ancient Kaldorei ruin, formerly almost abandoned, where the usual forest sounds are still. Currently, Forest Song is inhabited by a band of night elves and draenei who are building an outpost there. The fortifications are being put up in order to help the Silverwing Sentinels defend the area from the Warsong clan and the Burning Legion forces in the area, and to attempt to reclaim some of the damaged areas, like Felfire Hill. Sentinel Luciel Starwhisper, Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow, and Illiyana the dryad have all relocated to Forest Song i

Foreststrider Fledglings are level 12 tallstriders found in Darkshore. They are led by the Strider Clutchmother.
Forge Camp: Mageddon is the easternmost of three Burning Legion Forge Camps located on Hellfire Peninsula. It contains several gan'arg and a few succubi.
Forge Camp: Spite was supposed to be the last of three Burning Legion Forge Camps in Hellfire Peninsula in Outland. It did not make it out of beta.

Forge Base: Oblivion is one of the two Forge Bases in Netherstorm, situated just west of Eco-Dome Sutheron. It is full of wandering Burning Legion doomguard, gan'arg and fel reavers. It serves primarily as an assembly base for fel reavers.
Forge Camp: Fear is the southernmost of the two Burning Legion Forge Camps located in western Nagrand. It is led by Xirkos, Overseer of Fear.
Forge Camp: Hate is the northernmost of the two Burning Legion Forge Camps in western Nagrand. It is watched over By Demos, Overseer of Hate.

Forest spiders are easily as large as a dog, with striking greenish patterns upon its dark exoskeleton. These large spiders are quite common in Ashenvale. There are several types, each 3 feet in diameter with dark amber or greenish coloration. In some places, several swarms weave masses of webs throughout the forest, catching birds and deer. While forest spiders will avoid mobile humans, they will attack any helpless animals as prey. Forest spiders are accompanied a variety of scavengers and carnivorous plants. Corpses are covered in silk to disguise them and keep the area clean. Unlike their tiny brethren, forest spiders are social creatures. They hunt together, dropping down on large prey.
Forest Wind Shoulderpads are epic leather shoulder armor for druids that drop from The Curator in Karazhan.
Forestlord Striders are boots for healers that can be obtained by winning the Chess Event in Karazhan.
The Forest Stalker's Bracers is an Warsong Gulch PvP reward.

The Forlorn Cloister is the first area of the Scarlet Monastery. Wraiths and zombies wander throughout the graveyard, where members of the Scarlet Crusade are busily burning corpses to try and stem the tide of the undead. Thalnos the Soulrender resides here, attacking any foolhardy enough to trespass in his domain. During the Hallow's End seasonal event, players can queue to battle the Headless Horseman here, in a separate version of the instance.
Forestwalker Kilt is an epic leather legs armor for feral druids.
A Shrouded Figure wants to meet you in person for Formal Introductions.
Forked Tongues drop from level 11-62 wind serpents, serpents and snakes.
Forge Camp Legionnaires are felguard found at Forge Camp: Rage and Invasion Point: Annihilator in Hellfire Peninsula.
The Forged Seal of Ascension is located in Dustwallow Marsh. After being forged with 's help.
Forgosh is a fleshbeast found in the Netherstorm. He is one of several prisoners that can be released from an Ethereum Prison by using an Ethereum Prison Key.
Forest Troll Tusks drop from forest troll trash mobs inside Zul'Aman.
__NOTOC__ Forgemaster Morug is a mo'arg who holds command over Forge Base: Oblivion in the Netherstorm. He can be enslaved by warlocks.
Forlorn Souls are shades located at the Isle of Spears in the Howling Fjord.
Forgotten Servants are ghouls found in Acherus: The Ebon Hold summoned by Lady Alistra from the Realm of Shadows for her Disciples. It seems that they once served Lady Alistra.

Forlorn Mine connects Sifreldar Village and Brunnhildar Village in the southern reaches of the Storm Peaks. Notable within the mine is Lok'lira the Crone who, once you help her recover her runes, Provides you with an illusion that allows you to travel within the mine, and within Brunnhildar Village without being attacked on sight by the inhabitants.

The Forlorn Woods cover the western half of Crystalsong Forest. The woods are bordered by Icecrown and Storm Peaks to the north, the Unbound Thicket to the east, Dragonblight to the south, the Azure Front, the Violet Stand and the Great Tree to the southwest, and the Decrepit Flow to the northwest. The woods are bisected by the Twilight Rivulet running from the Decrepit Flow to the Mirror of Twilight and Dalaran floats high above. It is a place that looks perpetually in autumn, yellow and red-brown and dotted with lonely elf ruins. According to Muradin Bronzebeard, it is the safest place in the region that isn't someone's outpost to bide the night or to stop for a meal.

Forgol is a male shaman from the Krenka tribe of centaur who live in the Barrens. After having a vision showing the final resting place of Krenka, the tribe founder, he resolved to find the remains and return them to his tribe. :"The Krenka have not been doing well of late. Rival centaur clans slowly gobble up Krenka lands, and recent raids against orcs, tauren and harpies have been poor at best." He wanted to do this in order to help his tribe during their troubling times, but also hoped to move up in the tribe hierarchy if he succeeded. He traveled with an escort of centaur to the Wailing Caverns but it is implied that he eventually ran into a group of heroes and his mission was thwarted.

.]] The Forge of Wills is a large forge watched over by Sjonnir the Ironshaper within Halls of Stone. It can only be entered after the Tribunal of Ages event has been completed. It is surrounded by dormant iron vrykul. After the fight with Sjonnir, Brann Bronzebeard speculates that another location is making more of them (either the Iron Crucible or the Colossal Forge). The Forge of Wills and its twin, the Forge of Origination, were built by the titanic watchers Mimiron and Archaedas after the Old Gods were defeated. Their purpose was to help infuse Azeroth's slumbering world-soul with cosmic energies. The Forge of Wills would shape the world-soul's sentience, while the Forge of Origination

Forge of Fate is a small area in Dalaran where miners, blacksmiths, and engineers can go to craft their goods. Within Forge of Fate there is the Enchanted Anvil. In Legion, the Enchanted Anvil was removed, and the Obliterum Forge replaced it. Trader Caelen is there to help you with information about the forge. pl:Forge of Fate
Forgotten Captains can be found at the Forgotten Shore in Dragonblight. They are gryphon riders and former members of the 1st Legion.

The Forest of Shadows is a dark forest in southwestern Wintergrasp. Shadow Revenants and Wandering Shadows, which drop Quiver of Dragonbone Arrows for the quest Bones and Arrows, can be found throughout the forest.

Forgotten Footmen can be found on the Forgotten Shore in the Dragonblight. These footmen are former members of the 1st Legion. Along with the Forgotten Knights, they are some of the rare military units to wear a Lordaeron tabard.
The Formation Grounds is a subzone of Ulduar located in the outside part of the instance. Flame Leviathan resides within here.
This item is a reward from the quest Into the Breach (Grizzly Hills)
The Forgotten Overlook is an icy cliff that overlooks Heart's Blood Shrine in the Grizzly Hills.

The Forgotten Necklace can be found inside the Tiny Titanium Lockbox, found in turn inside the Bag of Fishing Treasures (Dalaran) rewarded from completing Marcia Chase's daily fishing quests in Dalaran.

The Forge of Souls is the first wing of the Frozen Halls instances in Icecrown Citadel, released in patch 3.3. The Forge is a massive production facility that contains soul grinders, the latest foul construct in the Lich King's arsenal. Queuing for the Forge of Souls in the Dungeon Finder requires level 80 and that one's gear have an average item level of 180.
Forgotten Depths High Priests are nerubian viziers located at Scourgeholme in Icecrown.
Forgotten Depths Underkings are crypt lords located at Scourgeholme in Icecrown.
Forgotten Depths Ambusher appear from underneath a cocoon in the Valley of Echoes in Icecrown.
Forgotten Depths Slayer can be found in Valley of Echoes in Icecrown. After the Argent Crusade have conquered the valley they won't appear.
Forgotten Depths Acolyte can be found in Valley of Echoes in Icecrown. After the Argent Crusade have conquered the valley they won't appear.
Forest Swarmers are orchids that thrive in the Conservatory of Life in Ulduar, they act as an assistant to the Guardian Lasher.
This is a page listing loot to be found in Forge of Souls. For information about the instance itself, see Forge of Souls.
This item has a chance to be in the Heart-Shaped Box and Heart-Shaped Carton from Apothecary Hummel, Apothecary Baxter, and Apothecary Frye in Shadowfang Keep during the Love is in the Air event.
Forgotten Dwarven Artifact is a quest item for Dwarven Artifacts.
Forgemaster Throngus is the second boss that can be found in Grim Batol.
Forged Iron Troggs spawn from the Forge of Wills in the Halls of Stone during the Sjonnir The Ironshaper encounter.

The Forgotten Crypt lies behind the tower of Karazhan, in the cemetery at Morgan's Plot. The purpose of the crypt was originally unknown. Players theorized they may have been playground for developers, a testing site of sorts, an unfinished instance, or something else entirely. In vanilla World of Warcraft, the area could be accessed via dying close to the gate and running through it as a ghost, but this was changed in patch 2.0.1.
Forgehammer Weapons is a provided by Mackay Firebeard for Somethin' for the Boys to be delivered to Iain Firebeard.
The Forge of Supplication is a friendly Twilight's Hammer settlement within the Darkwhisper Gorge of Mount Hyjal.

Forgotten soldier's Tombstones are found in the Forgotten Hill graveyard on Tol Barad Peninsula. They mark the resting place of fallen soldiers. (The same markers are used for both factions.) The soldiers buried there are not resting peacefully, and representatives of your faction ask you to release their spirits (by channeling through the gravestones. The character interacts with them during the quest The Forgotten.
The following NPCs can be found inside the Forge of Souls instance.
Forged Elementium Mindcrusher is created with Blacksmithing (520); taught by Plans: Forged Elementium Mindcrusher.

Forest nymphs are a race that have apparently evolved from dryads and found in warm environments, usually in forests. The term nymph is interchangeable with dryad. Nymphs are a wilder variation. A few forest nymphs have joined the Alliance, where they work alongside the night elves.
__NOTOC__ Foriel Broadleaf is a night elf found at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore. He was present at the grove when the Horde invaded it during the War of the Thorns.

The Forlorn Hut is a pandaren crafted hut built in the Pei-Wu Forest by Wei Palerage. Many of the Horde survivors from the Skyseeker crash ended up here. Several crewmen are injured, while others are quickly gathering up bamboos in order to craft crude weapons. Horde druids are also trying to heal the wounded.
Forlorn Highborne are wraiths found at the Bashal'Aran Collapse in Darkshore.
Forest Song Peacekeepers are draenei peacekeepers protecting Forest Song in Ashenvale.
__NOTOC__ Forest Spiderlings are venom spiders found throughout Stranglethorn.

Forest Spirits are creep units in Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos. They appear only in the orc mission The Spirits of Ashenvale. They have the appearance of ghosts, and are listed as undead. They guarded a number of artifacts held within circles of mushrooms from the invading Warsong clan.
The Forgotten Mire is nestled between the southern end of the Terrace of Gurthan and the Writhingwood in east-central Dread Wastes. The mire is inhabited by mistlurkers and water striders.
Forgewire Axe is created with Blacksmithing (545); taught by trainers.

Forge of the Endless is a large mogu construct machine found within the Mogu'shan Vaults. The device has been silent for centuries until reactivated by the heroes. The Will of the Emperor encounter takes place here.
The Forgotten Lockbox can be found on the second floor of the Tavern in the Mists at The Veiled Stair, above the Valley of the Four Winds. Looting it awards ~20,000 XP and around nine to ten gold.

Forgemaster Deng is a tomb marker located at at the southeastern end of the Court of Bones on the Isle of Thunder. Using the Incantation of Deng, which is a rare drop off of any mob on the isle, Deng can be summoned from beyond the grave. This is a requirement of the Isle of Thunder quest achievements The Mogu Below-gu and These Mogu Have Gotta Go-gu.
Forgotten Depths is a raid achievement for defeat the bosses in the ancient caverns beneath the Throne of Thunder.
Forged Iron Dwarves are iron dwarves located in Halls of Stone.
Forgemaster's Log is the personal diary of Millhouse Manastorm, located at Deathwing's Fall in Deepholm. It details Manastorm's upcoming meeting with High Priestess Azil at the Upper Silvermarsh.
Forgotten King is a mogu in the Crypt of Forgotten Kings scenario.
Forgemaster Vul'kon appears inside a quest scenario that takes place in the Thunder Forges for the quest The Thunder Forge (quest). He is the boss of Stage 3.

Forest Trickster's Leggings drop from the following NPCs in the Jade Forest of Pandaria. *Urobi the Walker *Aethis *Ferdinand *Morgrinn Crackfang *Kor'nas Nightsavage *Mister Ferocious *Sarnak *Krax'ik
Forgotten Supplies is found at atop a watch tower on Stonefang Ridge, just southeast of Stonefang Outpost in south-central Frostfire Ridge. It contains 30-40 Garrison Resources.
Forlorn Spiritshard is a quest reward. It turns a character's appearance a ghostly violet upon consumption.
Forgemaster Gog'duh, alongside the elemental Magmolatus, is one of the first two bosses in Bloodmaul Slag Mines. He is a geomancer of the Bloodmaul clan.

The Forge Grounds, once known as Nethergarde Supply Camps, is the area outside Nethergarde Mines in the Blasted Lands. The Iron Horde have taken over this land and use it as an outpost to continue mining out the nearby mine.
Forest Troll Shadow Priests are forest troll shadow priest creeps that can be encountered in many tilesets.
Forest Troll High Priests are forest troll priest creeps that can be encountered in many tilesets - primarily Lordaeron and Village alongside their Fall variants.

The Forlorn Composer is wandering the northeast corner of the Raven Hill Cemetery in Duskwood. Players may only see and interact with the composer while they are dead. For players who have completed Bringing the Bass, the composer is willing to interact with them: : : : You receive item: Music Roll: Ghost.
Forika the Seer is an arakkoa located at the Aktar's Post in Tanaan Jungle.
Forge-O-Matic 3000 XL is a crowd pummeler located outside Sprocket's Garage in Stormshield.
The Forge of Corruption is a demonic forge on Mardum used to create weapons and constructs for the Burning Legion.
Forgotten Letter appears at Caer Darrow in Western Plaguelands during Finding the Scepter.
Forgotten Missive appears in Hall of the Guardian during Finding Ebonchill.
Forgotten Dead are undead that have a chance to appear while raising corpses in the graveyard near Karazhan in Deadwind Pass during A Grisly Task.
Forged for Battle is awarded after completing your Order Hall Campaign and A Hero's Weapon.

Forgotten Knights can be found on the Forgotten Shore in the Dragonblight. These knights are former members of the 1st Legion. Along with the Forgotten Footmen, they are some of the rare military units to wear a Lordaeron tabard.
Forgotten Riflemen are dwarf ghosts of the 1st Legion located in Forgotten Shore in Dragonblight.
Forgotten Peasants are human ghosts of the 1st Legion located in Forgotten Shore, Dragonblight.
Forgotten Wailers are banshees located at the Ruby Dragonshrine in the Dragonblight in The Deaths of Chromie scenario.
Forgotten Techniques of the Broken Isles is an inscription item sold by Jang Quillpaw in Dalaran for .
Forge Camp: Spite Plans is obtained in Forge Camp: Spite in Hellfire Peninsula.
__NOTOC__ The Forgotten Crystal Tender is an eredar located at Azurelight Square in Eredath. She seems to own a few Domesticated Marsuul.
The Forgotten Legion Supplies can be found in a cave at the Felfire Armory in the Antoran Wastes.
Forgotten Spirits are banshees located throughout the Arcway.
Forgalash's Den is an underwater cave found at Azuregale Bay, Suramar. The cave is named after the skrog King Forgalash. However, he is not present in the game. The cave holds a small treasure chest.
__NOTOC__ Forgotten Denizens are eredar located in Eredath. One of them own a Domesticated Chitinbuk. They also appear at Kil'jaeden's Terrace during Bully Pulpit‎.
Forest Vipers are snakes located at Fletcher's Hollow in Drustvar.

The Forlorn Lovers is a boss that can be encountered in the single-player experience in the The Witchwood expansion for Hearthstone, consisting of a female human ghost who apparently refuses to let go of the grave of a loved one.
Forgotten Vindicator's Blade is looted from Hope in Talador.
__NOTOC__ Forgemaster Zak'aal is a dire troll located at the Terrace of Crafters in Dazar'alor.

Forgotten Offering is a potential reward from the following Class Hall missions: *Advanced Taxidermy *Dogs of Death *Stormy Skies *The Nameless King (class hall mission) *The Undying (class hall mission) It is also a quest reward from normal Broken Isles world quests and can be found inside Curious Wyrmtongue Cache.
Forged in Lava is an Enhancement shaman artifact trait. It is linked to the Doom Vortex and Stormflurry (artifact trait) traits.
Forgotten Conservatory Sash can be obtained from the Ancient Eredar Cache in Eredath.
__NOTOC__ Forest Sisters are dryads and forest nymphs located in Lor'danel in Darkshore fighting the Horde following the Burning of Teldrassil.
Forgotten Conservatory Slippers can be obtained from Ancient Eredar Cache in Eredath.
The Forgotten Caves pale is a group of pale orcs who dwell in the Forgotten Caves. They have developed a symbiosis relationship with the spiders whose venom drives their victims to insanity.
Forgalash's Prow dropped from King Forgalash in Forgalash's Den in Suramar.
Forgotten Conservatory Gloves can be looted from the Ancient Eredar Caches in Eredath.

The Forgotten Marsh is a shallow marsh on the western coast of Vol'dun, immediately north of the Terrace of the Devoted. It serves as the home of the Tideflat murlocs. During Naga Attack!, the marsh is overtaken by the Darktide naga, deep sea murlocs, and their sethrak captives.
__NOTOC__ Forest Sproutling did not make it out of the Warlords of Draenor beta.
Forgotten Peacekeeper Breastplate is a world drop from mobs in the Throne of Thunder or Isle of Thunder.
The Forgotten Designs of the Broken Isles is sold by Pika in Zuldazar and Tiffany Cartier in Dalaran.

Forlorn Crossing is a crossroads between Bashal'Aran, Gloomtide Strand, Cinderfall Grove, and Ashwood Depot in Darkshore. When the Alliance controls Darkshore, a lot of night elven forces patrol the area.

The Forgotten Tunnel is a cave located at the Spears of Azshara in Nazjatar. The Chasm-Haunter makes its home here, guarded by a few Abyssal Eels and a Coral Slitherer. The water entrance is also full of Deeptide frenzies.
__NOTOC__ The Forgotten Hollow is a cave in the southwestern part of the Valley of Sorrows in Vol'dun. It is here that Meijani performs the ritual to restore Akunda's memories.
